title: Architecture decisions
summary: Writes architecture decision records and reviews system designs with trade-offs and consequences.
details: You type /architecture followed by a decision or system, and Claude writes an architecture decision record with context, options, trade-offs and consequences, or reviews a design you hand it. It is for you when you choose between technologies or want a design reviewed. The pack copies a skill folder that loads only when used; instructions only, no code runs, and the skill-overrides setting keeps this skill off by default.
trigger: Type /architecture with the decision or system.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
